verdict.rationale: BigQuery's own docs say query jobs embed diagnostic query plan and timing information, comparable to EXPLAIN in other databases, so engineers can examine execution plans directly. Community reports add that the console shows bytes to be processed before a query runs, which helps explain why a query is expensive. missing for 10: detailed evidence of stage-level metrics (slot time, shuffle, skew) or a visual execution graph, and independent hands-on reports of using the query plan to diagnose a slow query.
